title: Distinctiveness of Organisational Intelligence
question: Is Organisational Intelligence sufficiently distinct from collective intelligence, organisational learning, knowledge management, coordination, dynamic capability, information processing, culture, performance and AI capability to justify one coherent construct?
why_open: The chapters integrate several established literatures; integration can create construct inflation or relabelling without discriminant validity.
source_basis: TRACE known gaps; V1; all chapter construct limitations; GLO critical distinctions
minimum_disposition_or_evidence: State necessary and non-necessary components, adjacent-construct boundaries, counterexamples and claims not made.
source_or_synthesis: Project OI cross-source synthesis; not a direct source statement
working_disposition_v0_2: Retain OI as a bounded integrative working construct; distinctiveness requires discriminant and predictive validation.
release_status_v0_2: Working construct disposition established; empirical question remains open

title: Parsimony of the three transformations and six capabilities
question: Are Orient, Coordinate and Improve, implemented through Sense, Know, Choose, Mobilise, Learn and Adapt, the most parsimonious architecture for the source material?
why_open: The model is a Project OI synthesis rather than an established taxonomy under the same labels.
source_basis: SYN roadmap decisions; PROP O-class propositions; TRACE V1–V3
minimum_disposition_or_evidence: Demonstrate full coverage, non-redundancy, semantic ownership and why alternative decompositions are less useful.
post_release_status: Requires field and comparative construct testing.
source_or_synthesis: Project OI cross-source synthesis; not a direct source statement
working_disposition_v0_2: Retain three transformations and six operational capabilities; necessity and independence remain empirical.
release_status_v0_2: Working construct disposition established; empirical question remains open
next_empirical_target: Requires field and comparative construct testing.

title: Status of Contextualise, Orientation and Outcome–Feedback
question: Should Contextualise remain a connective mechanism, Orientation an integrative state and Outcomes–Feedback a bridge rather than operational capabilities?
why_open: These constructs are essential but do not have equivalent chapter or capability status.
source_basis: SYN RD-003/RD-004; TRACE stage and gap registers; GLO open decisions
minimum_disposition_or_evidence: Define each object, owner, inputs, outputs and non-capability status without weakening the end-to-end model.
post_release_status: Retain as a construct-design question for later empirical work.
source_or_synthesis: Project OI cross-source synthesis; not a direct source statement
working_disposition_v0_2: Contextualise and Outcome–Feedback are connective mechanisms; Organisational Orientation is an integrated state.
release_status_v0_2: Working construct disposition established; empirical question remains open
next_empirical_target: Retain as a construct-design question for later empirical work.

title: Connection Quality
question: Is Connection Quality a distinct and useful integrative construct, and how can it be observed without becoming a universal score?
why_open: The strongest cross-chapter finding is that local capability can exist while transitions fail, but the term is a Project OI working synthesis.
source_basis: GLO 10.1; PROP loop-closure cluster; TRACE transition register and known gap
minimum_disposition_or_evidence: Provide a bounded definition, transition evidence model, non-circular indicators and clear distinction from coordination, integration and process quality.
post_release_status: Requires process-tracing and handoff validation in field cases.
source_or_synthesis: Project OI cross-source synthesis; not a direct source statement
working_disposition_v0_2: Retain Connection Quality as a provisional integrative research hypothesis and diagnostic lens, not a capability or score.
release_status_v0_2: Working construct disposition established; empirical question remains open
next_empirical_target: Requires process-tracing and handoff validation in field cases.

title: Unit of analysis
question: What organisational unit can validly be described as possessing Organisational Intelligence?
why_open: Chapter sources span individuals, teams, organisations, ecosystems and technical systems.
source_basis: V3 applies to 103 propositions; limitations in Chapters 3–6, 8–9
minimum_disposition_or_evidence: State focal unit, nested levels, aggregation mechanisms and what evidence is insufficient for organisation-level attribution.
source_or_synthesis: Project OI cross-source synthesis; not a direct source statement
working_disposition_v0_2: Use a bounded Organisational System with a mandatory claim-boundary and multilevel evidence protocol.
release_status_v0_2: Working construct disposition established; empirical question remains open

title: Emergence and persistence
question: What converts distributed individual and technical contributions into an organisation-level capability that persists beyond participants and episodes?
why_open: The working definition requires persistence and institutionalisation, but source mechanisms vary by domain.
source_basis: Chapters 3, 8 and 9; PROP clusters on possession, memory and institutionalisation
minimum_disposition_or_evidence: Define emergence, persistence, continuity and loss conditions across people, routines, structures and systems.
source_or_synthesis: Project OI cross-source synthesis; not a direct source statement
working_disposition_v0_2: Define persistence beyond one episode and require evidence of repeated enactment, retention, transfer, recovery or later use.
release_status_v0_2: Working construct disposition established; empirical question remains open

title: Transition mechanisms and temporal order
question: Are the proposed transition mechanisms and temporal relationships among the OI stages supported and properly bounded?
why_open: The 14 transitions are coherent cross-chapter syntheses rather than validated causal pathways.
source_basis: TRACE transition register; V4 applies to 122 propositions
minimum_disposition_or_evidence: State which links are logical dependencies, empirical mechanisms, recursive relations or optional routes.
post_release_status: Requires longitudinal process tracing and comparative cases.
source_or_synthesis: Project OI cross-source synthesis; not a direct source statement
working_disposition_v0_2: Retain feedback-coupled conversion as a recursive proposed mechanism, not a validated universal causal order.
release_status_v0_2: Working construct disposition established; empirical question remains open
next_empirical_target: Requires longitudinal process tracing and comparative cases.

title: Loop closure and recurrence
question: What evidence demonstrates that feedback and adaptation actually change future sensing, knowing, choosing, mobilisation and execution?
why_open: All chapters point forward, but closure of the complete feedback loop is not field-validated.
source_basis: PROP loop-closure cluster; TRACE final transition; Chapters 7–9
minimum_disposition_or_evidence: Define loop-closure evidence and distinguish one-off correction from persistent changed capability.
source_or_synthesis: Project OI cross-source synthesis; not a direct source statement
working_disposition_v0_2: Require a trace from evaluation to retained learning to later changed response or readiness evidence.
release_status_v0_2: Working construct disposition established; empirical question remains open

title: Capability and performance circularity
question: How can capability be inferred without defining it by successful performance and then using capability to explain success?
why_open: Dynamic-capability and OI claims risk circularity.
source_basis: Chapter 9 Performance Circularity; V4/V6; DIAG outcome proxy warnings
minimum_disposition_or_evidence: Separate capability configuration and behaviour evidence from outcome evidence and specify failure-compatible capability claims.
source_or_synthesis: Project OI cross-source synthesis; not a direct source statement
working_disposition_v0_2: Separate capability, implementation, outcome and external conditions to reduce circularity.
release_status_v0_2: Working construct disposition established; empirical question remains open

title: Contextual and sector generalisability
question: Which mechanisms remain stable and which vary across SMBs, large enterprises, public organisations, regulated settings, cultures and ecosystems?
why_open: Many sources come from bounded sectors, large firms, technical systems or high-reliability settings.
source_basis: V8 applies to all 182 propositions; chapter generalisability limitations
minimum_disposition_or_evidence: State expected invariants, context-sensitive mechanisms and explicit non-generalisations.
source_or_synthesis: Project OI cross-source synthesis; not a direct source statement
working_disposition_v0_2: State expected invariants and contextual mechanisms; make no universal sector claim.
release_status_v0_2: Working construct disposition established; empirical question remains open

title: Operationalising Organisational Intelligence
question: Can OI be observed without substituting repositories, documents, meetings, decisions, uptime, outcomes, AI benchmarks or other weak proxies for the underlying capabilities?

source_basis: V6 applies to 124 propositions; DIAG evidence-role model and proxy warnings
minimum_disposition_or_evidence: Define an evidence portfolio, construct-to-indicator logic, exclusions and no-single-score rule.
source_or_synthesis: Project OI cross-source synthesis; not a direct source statement
working_disposition_v0_2: Use bounded claims and multi-role evidence portfolios; no validated composite score.
release_status_v0_2: Working construct disposition established; empirical question remains open

title: Sense quality source gap

why_open: Adding quality dimensions retrospectively would misattribute synthesis to the chapter.

title: Evidence portfolio and assessment design
question: Which combination of enabling, process, transition, governance, direct behaviour, outcome, risk and learning evidence is sufficient for a bounded OI claim?
why_open: The proposed portfolio is a synthesis candidate, not a validated instrument.
source_basis: DIAG candidate evidence portfolio; TRACE indicator roles
minimum_disposition_or_evidence: Specify portfolio logic, claim boundaries, corroboration requirements and prohibited inference.

title: Outcome, attribution and contribution
question: How should OI evaluation distinguish capability, implementation, outcome, contribution and causal effect?
why_open: Favourable outcomes can be caused by context or luck; causal designs are often infeasible.
source_basis: Chapter 7 limitations; V4/V6; DIAG outcome evidence warnings
minimum_disposition_or_evidence: State causal-claim hierarchy and prevent outcome contamination of capability measures.
source_or_synthesis: Project OI cross-source synthesis; not a direct source statement
working_disposition_v0_2: Use descriptive, contribution and attribution claim levels matched to evidence.

title: Purpose, legitimacy and responsible use
question: Can an organisation be instrumentally intelligent while pursuing harmful, illegitimate or unethical purposes, and how should the construct represent that distinction?
why_open: Each domain can operate effectively in service of harmful goals.
source_basis: GLO 10.12; V7 applies to 92 propositions; chapter normative limitations
minimum_disposition_or_evidence: Separate descriptive capability from responsible exercise while preserving one construct and explicit normative commitments.
post_release_status: Requires ethical, legal and stakeholder research.
source_or_synthesis: Project OI cross-source synthesis; not a direct source statement
working_disposition_v0_2: Retain one descriptive construct; responsible exercise is a cross-cutting governance condition.
release_status_v0_2: Working construct disposition established; empirical question remains open
next_empirical_target: Requires ethical, legal and stakeholder research.

title: Power and representation
question: How do power, hierarchy, incentives and official representations shape which signals, memories, stakeholders and outcomes become part of the OI cycle?
why_open: Formal process models can conceal coercion, marginalised experience and selective organisational memory.
source_basis: Chapters 4, 5, 7 and 8 limitations; V7
minimum_disposition_or_evidence: Integrate power as a cross-cutting condition and identify contestability, dissent and representation requirements.
source_or_synthesis: Project OI cross-source synthesis; not a direct source statement
working_disposition_v0_2: Treat power as cross-cutting and preserve critical, labour-process, stakeholder and rights-based research as a priority gap.
release_status_v0_2: Working construct disposition established; empirical question remains open

question: How should authority, accountability, review, appeal and intervention operate consistently from attention through adaptation?

minimum_disposition_or_evidence: Define cross-stage authority relationships and prevent technical capability from becoming implied organisational authority.
source_or_synthesis: Project OI cross-source synthesis; not a direct source statement
